name: Velvet Solitaire
shortDescription: Klondike on a velvet table, with cards that have real thickness and weight.
description: A one-page Klondike solitaire you host on your own site. The table is lit felt with cloth sheen and a lacquered wood rail; the cards are thick, rounded, and glossy, tilt as you drag them, cast soft shadows, and settle with a snap. Draw one or three, standard or Vegas scoring (the deck costs $52 and pays $5 a card, and the bank carries from game to game), unlimited undo in standard, hints, auto-finish, a clock and a move count, and the classic win cascade with fading trails. Plays with touch, mouse, and keyboard, keeps a half-played game on the device, and comes in three tables, each with a day and a night look.
